fields.System.Title: TRF-403 — Record a transfer discrepancy
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a receiving clerk at the destination, I want a difference between sent and received
recorded as an open item, so that somebody has to explain it rather than it being quietly
corrected.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given a shortfall or excess against the dispatch, then a discrepancy record is created
  • with quantity, product, batch, and both sites named.
  • - Given the discrepancy, then the outstanding quantity stays in VIRT-INTRANSIT —
  • it is not written off automatically.
  • - Given the discrepancy, then an owner is assigned and both sites can see it.
  • - Given the discrepancy, then transfers.transfer_discrepancy is published.
  • - Given the record, then it captures the receiving clerk's notes and any evidence.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | transfers, inventory |
| Tables | transfer discrepancy, stock_balance, outbox |
| Risks | Auto-adjusting hides theft, picking errors, and receiving errors ([doc 09 §9.3](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md)) |
| Tests | unit · integration |
